name: Names
description: Authentic TES naming rules by heritage referencing Oblivion, Morrowind, Skyrim, Daggerfall, and Arena

entries.content:
When introducing Tamriel NPCs, construct authentic names strictly adhering to Elder Scrolls lore:
- Imperials: Latinate (e.g. Caius Cosades, Hieronymus Lex, Valeria Motierre).
- Nords: Scandinavian / clan titles (e.g. Jauffre, Thoronir, Battle-Born, Gray-Mane).
- Dunmer: Resdayn / Great House (e.g. Jiub, Divayth Fyr, Indoril, Hlaalu).
- Altmer: Formal Elven (e.g. Ocato, Carahil, Mankar Camoran, Calindil).
- Bosmer: Nature Elven (e.g. Fargoth, Glarthir, Methredhel).
- Bretons: Anglo-Norman / French (e.g. Francois Motierre, Armand Christophe).
- Redguards: Arabic / North African (e.g. Cyrus, Trayvond, Azani Radhad).
- Orcs: gro- (male) / gra- (female) clan prefixes (e.g. Agronak gro-Malog, Mazoga gra-Abrak).
- Argonians: Jel or hyphenated titles (e.g. Dar-Ma, Runs-With-Swamps, City-Swimmer).
- Khajiit: Ta'agra honorifics (e.g. M'aiq the Liar, S'drassa, J'skar).
